title: Model creation with blender and Claude code
author: Discodowns
selftext: How are people creating 3d models using blender? Are ye using Hyper3D Rodin? Or are ye doing something else? I passed in a character design created with chat gpt in an A-pose but the resulting model was bloody awful. Super blocky. Looked out of a bad Minecraft clone. The game mechanics I'm making are going well, but I'm struggling with creating characters and animating them.

comments.author: Cheese_Viking
comments.body:
Astra is a lot better than fable for this at the moment, but it's still not that good with characters and animations.

I just burned my entire 200 USD chatgpt usage on generating one character based on some image gen references. The result is alright, but not that good and very inefficient.

I think its best to just buy some animation and asset packs and use those as a starting point for now. 

Perhaps in a few months the models will be good enough to do it from scratch

replies.author: Cheese_Viking
replies.body: Codex is really nice with the built-in image gen btw, so it can generate a reference before trying to implement something. It seems to help quite a bit

replies.author: Edgezg
replies.body: So what I'm hearing is that we should wait a bit for things to improve more before diving into this? lol

comments.author: Novaworld7
comments.body: Right now im fighting both Fable and Astra when using a Meshy rigged sculpt. Its a real pain, but I think im getting somewhere... maybe...

comments.author: Key-Internet-1665
comments.body: I’d honestly recommend learning the basics of Blender and making simple models yourself, AI generators can help with a starting point but the topology and proportions usually need a lot of cleanup.

replies.author: SubstantialYard4072
replies.body: That’s the issue with Ai across the board if you know how to do something it’s faster to not use it but when you have no clue it does a poor job and people don’t know.

comments.author: maartendeblock
comments.body: Use the Blender MCP. You can see what is happening and give instructions.

comments.author: Kingnorik
comments.body: I personally haven't tried to let Astra create a model from scratch. Meshy and so many other services already do that for cheap. $20 a month is nothing. Not going to waste my Astra tokens on something that has already been solved.

replies.author: Discodowns
replies.body: Yeah I saw there's a couple tools and stuff and I tried some out but how do you handle animating them?

replies.author: Kingnorik
replies.body: I will let Astra try animating. But it does require some animation knowledge I believe in blender or you'll just be shooting in the dark. You need to know the basics of key frames.

comments.author: chunky_lover92
comments.body: It's helpful, but it won't do everything for you.
